This is my absolute favorite makeup brush I own! I can get some amazing contour with it. I'm a licensed cosmetologist so I was skeptical with the price being so low, but it's really a great deal. And none of the brush hairs have fallen out! Highly recommend this!

This brush works well for contouring. I was looking for an alternative to the Nars 'ita' because I didn't have $55 to spend on a brush. This is a great option at an unbeatable price. The bristles are soft and the brush is high quality. I definitely recommend it.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brush for contouring, saying it works well and places product precisely.
Many reviewers describe the bristles as soft yet firm and the brush as high quality, especially for the price.
Several reviewers note the brush is thicker than expected, which some like but at least one found too thick for a realistic contour line.
A few reviewers report durability and quality problems, including the handle coming unglued, a missing brush top, and a loose metallic part.
One reviewer mentions an awful smell on first receiving the brush that went away after washing.
